description: This file defines the SearchService interface, outlining methods for indexing products, deleting indexes, keyword search, product search, and service initialization within a sales management system.

classes.name: SearchService
classes.description: Interface providing search-related operations such as indexing, deleting, searching keywords, product search, and service initialization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a product for a specific merchant store, should be called when a product is created or updated.

methods.name: deleteIndex
methods.description: Deletes a product index for a specific merchant store, should be called when a product is deleted.

methods.name: searchForKeywords
methods.description: Provides keyword suggestions based on a partial input, used for auto-complete functionality.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs product search based on user input, returning search results.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Initializes the search service to prevent lazy loading issues.
